description: What a script contains: its structure from the file, or symbols, completions and hover text from the editor's language server. Operations: structure: functions, variables, signals, class_name and extends, read from the file, and dependencies: the paths it loads or preloads as written, then the scripts declaring each project class_name its code uses, which classes_used names with the class; symbols: document symbols from the language server, each with its kind, the line and column of its name, and the lastLine of its declaration; completion (needs line, character): completions at a position, narrowed to the part of a name written before it, at most 100; hover (needs line, character): hover text at a position. Default structure.

character.description: completion, hover: the column, counted from 1 as the editor shows it, with a tab counted as one. symbols gives each name at the line and column hover is asked at.

includeInherited.description: structure: also list what the script inherits, walking extends through the project's other scripts. Each such member carries inherited_from, the file declaring it, and the answer gains inherits_from, the chain that was walked. A name the script overrides is listed at both its lines rather than once. A native base is not walked, since it declares nothing in a file: editor_classes info answers for those. Default false.

line.description: completion, hover: the line, counted from 1 as the editor shows it.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory, the one holding project.godot.

scriptPath.description: Script file inside the project, such as "scripts/player.gd".

name: script_info
title: Script info
